@@U04349@@
you hold your possessions forever, with the sole proviso that they are indivisible, and however much they are aggrandized by you, they will pass undiminished to your eldest son.

@@U04351@@
It will be done at once, Majesty, for the good of ourselves and the Empire. My office will see to the engrossment, the seal affixed and readied for your august signature.

@@U04353@@
And so I dismiss you, that each man of you may contemplate this day’s great events.

@@U04354@@
(The SECULAR PRINCES go out, the SPIRITUAL PRINCE remains.)

@@U04356@@
(With pathos.)

@@U04357@@
The Chancellor has withdrawn. It is the Bishop remains. Warned by an inner voice, he wishes to speak as a father with deep concern for his son.

@@U04359@@
But, Lord Bishop, what could possibly distress you on this happy occasion? Speak freely.

@@U04361@@
It grieves me, grieves me deeply at this hour to see your sacred head in league with Satan. Admittedly you sit safely on your throne, or so it seems, but in truth it is a mockery to God and the Holy Father, who, once informed, will exercise to the full extent of his powers the ban of excommunication on you
translation:
@@U04349@@
你永远拥有你的财产，唯一的条件是它们是不可分割的，无论你把它们扩大了多少，它们都会原封不动地传给你的长子。

@@U04351@@
为了我们和帝国的利益，陛下，这件事会立即完成。我的办公室将负责全神贯注、加盖印章并准备好供您威严的签名。

@@U04353@@
因此，我请你们解散，以便你们每个人都可以思考今天的重大事件。

@@U04354@@
（世俗王子走了，精神王子留下来。）

@@U04356@@
（带着悲情。）

@@U04357@@
总理已退出。这是主教的遗骸。在内心声音的警告下，他希望以一位深切关心儿子的父亲的身份发言。

@@U04359@@
但是，主教大人，在这个欢乐的时刻，有什么可能让您感到困扰呢？畅所欲言。

@@U04361@@
此时此刻，看到你神圣的头颅与撒旦勾结，我感到非常悲伤，非常悲伤。诚然，你安全地坐在你的宝座上，或者看起来是这样，但事实上，这是对上帝和圣父的嘲弄，他一旦被告知，将充分行使他的权力，禁止对你逐出教会
